q1_issues.issue: "was up 9.05 points" is the copular scalar-change state the instruction set routes through a reified up-state carrying (MeasureBy <event> <scale> <mag> <unit>); the parse reifies nothing and stores a standing Measure on the index itself, under the scale symbol `increase` that no word in the sentence supplies (direction lives in the state lemma, never in an invented scale).

The restatement figure "or 0.94 percent" is stored the same wrong way — a second standing Measure with the invented `increase` scale rather than a second MeasureBy delta on the one change eventuality.

"at 972.64" is the change's end value (MeasureTo) but is asserted as the bearer's own timeless measure — exactly the reading Scalar change forbids — and both its slots are invented: the scale `level` is stated nowhere and the unit `point` is supplied by no word (a bare figure keeps unit `unspecified`).

notes: Name handling is right — one opaque multi-word symbol, verbatim Name string, the kind word inside the name stated as a separate type atom, the ticker <.SPX> dropped as a parenthetical secondary identifier, and the elided-standard comparative "broader" correctly left unencoded. The failure is uniform: the whole sentence is routed through standing Measure atoms on the entity instead of the Scalar-change heads, so the parse asserts three timeless properties of the index rather than one change.
